__from_email_tooltip: When on, any email that is not already routed to another connection is sent from this address, whatever From address the sending plugin set.
__wizard_sub: Connect WordPress to the email service you already use, so the mail your site sends actually arrives.
__wizard_instruction: Set up your first email connection
__alerts_hint: Get told when an email fails, on Slack, Telegram, Discord or Pushover, without watching the log.
__routing_rule: Mail sent from a connection's own From address always goes through that connection. Everything else goes through the Default, and if that fails, the Fallback.
__delete_connection_confirm: This connection will be removed and any email routed to it will fall back to the default connection. Delete it?
__default_connection_popover: The connection that sends everything not already routed by its own From address.
__fallback_connection_popover: Used when an email fails to send on another connection. Pick a different connection from the default.
__Email_Simulation_Label: Stop delivering email. Messages are still written to the log, so you can see what would have been sent.
__Email_Simulation_Yes: No email is leaving this site.
__RETURN_PATH_ALERT: The Return-Path is the address bounce notices are sent to. With this on, a message that bounces comes back to your From Email; with it off, the notice may be lost.
__RETURN_PATH_TOOLTIP: Return Path indicates where non - delivery receipts - or bounce messages - are to be sent. If unchecked, bounce messages may be lost. With this enabled, you\'ll be emailed using "From Email" if any messages bounce as a result of issues with the recipient\'s email.
__TEST_EMAIL_INST: Where to send the test. Your own account email is filled in by default.
__ABOUT_INTRO: is a free, open-source WordPress plugin. It connects your site to the email service you already use, so the mail WordPress sends is delivered rather than dropped.
__ABOUT_BY: FluentSMTP is free, and it will stay free. That is our pledge to the WordPress community, from WPManageNinja LLC.
__ABOUT_POWERED: FluentSMTP is built by the people who use it. Thanks to everyone who has contributed.
__ABOUT_COMMUNITY: We build FluentSMTP in the open, and what our users tell us is what we build next.
__ABOUT_JOIN: Join one of our communities and ask us anything.

__SMTP_CRED_HELP: Turn this on to send a username and password to the SMTP server. Most servers require it.
__ANOTHER_CONNECTION_NOTICE: Another connection already uses this address. Saving will replace it.
__EMAIL_LOGGING_OFF: Email logging is off. Only failed and resent emails appear here.
